title: Dragonfruit
body:
"Dragonfruit, also known as pitaya, is a tropical fruit with vibrant pink skin and white flesh speckled with black seeds."

Description

The Dragonfruit is an item that can be found on Acacia tree leaves (Inside the Desert) and can spawn 4-6 per tree.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $350 per Dragonfruit. In its jam form it may be sold for $800.

Slightly boosts mining power when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~4.7% per dragonfruit.

Trivia

  • Strangely enough, Dragonfruit does grow on cactuses, but it grows on trees and hangs on non-existent stem.
